title: MOVING2024: Motor imagery / motor execution dataset from the MOVING study
description: A motor imagery and motor execution EEG dataset from the MOVING study, recorded from 11 healthy participants with a 32-channel dry-electrode Neuroelectrics Enobio system. Participants performed rest, motor imagery and motor execution of three right-hand movements (open/close, wrist rotation, finger tapping), with Virtual Glove hand tracking acquired alongside the EEG. This BIDS release was converted from the published source data via MOABB.
methods_description: Thirty-two-channel dry-electrode EEG was recorded at 500 Hz (Neuroelectrics Enobio 32, 10-20 montage, CMS/DRL reference). Each trial comprised a 2 s fixation followed by a 6 s action. The rest, motor imagery and motor execution triplet was repeated eight times per subject for each of three right-hand movements, with cue-based visual presentation.
